hero.subtitle: myhouz gives your whole household one app to track what needs doing, what needs buying, and what needs fixing — right from your phone.

features.title: Everything your household needs.
features.subtitle: Built around how real households actually work — not how a productivity consultant thinks they should.
features.itemsDescription: Track everything the house needs — to buy, repair, or fix. Assign it to someone and mark it done.
features.routinesDescription: The weekly clean, the plant watering, the trash day. Set it once and everyone knows what's done.
features.remindersDescription: Renew the lease. Pay the bill. Assign reminders to the right person and stop relying on memory.
features.urgentDescription: Something broke? Flag it and every household member knows instantly — no need to spam the group chat.
features.membersDescription: Share a link. Your roommates, partner, or family join your household in seconds from their phone.
features.dashboardDescription: Open the app and see exactly where things stand — overdue, urgent, or already taken care of.

appShowcase.description1: Open the app and instantly know what's happening at home. Items, routines, reminders, and urgent problems — all in one screen.
appShowcase.description2: No more guessing who was supposed to buy what. Assign tasks, track completions, and keep your household running like clockwork.
appShowcase.bullet2b: See completion status in real time
appShowcase.bullet2c: Priority labels so nothing gets lost

howItWorks.title: Up and running in 3 steps
howItWorks.subtitle: No setup guide. No onboarding call. Just your household, organized.
howItWorks.step1Description: Get myhouz from the App Store. Create an account in thirty seconds. Free, no credit card.
howItWorks.step2Description: Give your home a name. Apartment 301, The Smith's — whatever feels right. You're the owner.
howItWorks.step3Description: Share a link. Roommates, partner, family — whoever lives with you joins instantly from their phone.

faq.title: Got questions?
faq.subtitle: Here are answers to the most common ones.
faq.a1: Yes! The free plan includes up to 3 household members, 50 items, 5 routine checklists, and 20 reminders. More than enough for most homes.
faq.a2: Absolutely. myhouz works on the web at myhouz.app, and on iOS via the App Store. Your data syncs across all devices instantly.
faq.q3: How do I invite my housemates?
faq.a3: Generate an invite link from the app and share it via WhatsApp, text, or email. Your housemates tap the link, create an account, and they're in.
faq.q4: Does it work for roommates, couples, and families?
faq.a4: Yes — myhouz is built for any group of people sharing a home. Roommates splitting chores, couples managing a household, or families coordinating daily life.
faq.a5: Your data is only visible to members of your household. We use Row Level Security at the database level so no one outside your household can see your information.
faq.a6: We're working on it! The Android version is coming soon. In the meantime, you can use the web app at myhouz.app from any device.

legal.pageTitle: Privacy Policy and Terms of Use
legal.privacyIntro: myhouz ("we", "our", "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and protect your information when you use the myhouz.app website and the myhouz mobile application (collectively, the "Service"). By using the Service, you agree to the practices described in this policy.
legal.p1Intro: We collect different types of information to provide and improve our Service:
legal.p1a: Device information: browser type, IP address, time zone, cookies, pages viewed, and how you interact with the Service
legal.p1b: Account information: email address, name and display name, and profile avatar, provided when you create your account
legal.p1c: Usage data: items created, routines and tasks managed, reminders set, household membership and role information, and activity history
legal.p2Intro: We use the following technologies to collect information automatically:
legal.p2a: Supabase authentication session cookies, required to keep you signed in to your account
legal.p2b: Server log files, which may record information such as IP address, browser type, and pages accessed
legal.p3Intro: We use the information we collect for the following purposes:
legal.p3a: Provide, operate, and maintain the Service
legal.p3c: Share household data with members of your household as intended by the Service
legal.p3d: Improve and optimize the platform through usage analytics
legal.p3e: Ensure platform security and prevent fraud
legal.p4Intro: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data. We may share your information in the following cases:
legal.p4a: Supabase: database infrastructure and authentication, where your data is stored and processed
legal.p4b: Google Sign-In and Apple Sign-In: used as authentication providers for platform login; we only receive basic profile information (name and email) necessary to create your account
legal.p4c: Sentry: error monitoring service that collects technical information (such as stack traces and device data) to identify and fix platform issues; it does not intentionally collect personally identifiable data
legal.p4d: Legal requirements: we may disclose your information if required by law, court order, or legal process
legal.p5Body: We use only essential cookies for the operation of the Service. Supabase session cookies are required for authentication and maintaining your session. We do not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies.
legal.p6Body: We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active. If you request account deletion, we will remove your personal data from our systems within 30 (thirty) calendar days, except where retention is necessary to comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, or enforce our agreements.
legal.p7Intro: Depending on your location, you have specific rights regarding your personal data:
legal.p7a: Access the personal data we hold about you
legal.p7b: Correct inaccurate or incomplete personal information
legal.p7c: Request deletion of your personal data and account
legal.p7d: Export your data in a portable format
legal.p7e: Withdraw consent for data processing at any time
legal.p8Body: If you reside in Brazil, the General Data Protection Law (LGPD) provides additional rights, including the right to request information about data processing, data portability, anonymization, blocking or deletion of unnecessary data, and the right to petition the National Data Protection Authority (ANPD). To exercise these rights, contact us at hello@myhouz.app.
legal.p9Body: We employ commercially reasonable security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. This includes encryption of data in transit, Row Level Security (RLS) policies at the database level to ensure users can only access data within their own household, and secure credential storage. No method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure, but we strive to protect your data.
legal.p10Body: The Service is not intended for individuals under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we become aware that we have collected data from a child under 13, we will take steps to delete that information from our servers within 30 days. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with personal data, please contact us at hello@myhouz.app so we can take appropriate action.
legal.p11Body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. The updated version will be posted on this page with a new effective date. We encourage you to review this page regularly to stay informed.
legal.t1Body: By accessing or using myhouz ("Service"), you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms of Use. If you do not agree to any part of these terms, you must not access or use the Service. These terms constitute a legal agreement between you and myhouz.
legal.t2Body: myhouz is a household management platform that allows users to organize and share tasks, items to buy, routines, reminders, and urgent problems with everyone living under the same roof. Users can create households, invite members, assign tasks, track completions, and manage their home collaboratively.

By posting content, you grant myhouz a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use, display, reproduce, and distribute that content solely for the purpose of operating the Service and sharing it with your household members. This license terminates when you delete the content or your account.
